task.title: Replace the concept-1c application icon with the squircle brick-S mark the redesigned app already renders
task.objective: Regenerate resources/icon-source.png, resources/icon.png and resources/icon.ico from the AwkitDarkBrandMark geometry that the awkit-lgn2 title bar and login wordmark already use (dark squircle, brick S, accent brick), point the sidebar brand tile at the same shared component so the sidebar and the OS icon stay identical, prove build + branding/token/offline verifiers, and reconcile project state. The Login page review against the proposed Login.dc.html design is an inspect-only report delivered in chat; no login markup changes.

compatibility: The OS icon is a baked raster: the accent brick is fixed at the design-system primary accent #7c3aed (brand-600, the default --awkit-accent), while in-app marks keep following var(--awkit-accent).
The sidebar brand tile stays on the dark finish in both themes, preserving the existing sidebar-equals-OS-icon rule; the title bar keeps its theme-following light/dark marks.
The dev-only Program Status dashboard (tools/roadmap/public/index.html) keeps its inline concept-1c SVG; it is derived tooling, never bundled, and outside this task's paths.
offline: Icon generation runs locally through the already-installed sharp dependency; no new dependency, font or network access.

acceptance.description: resources/icon.ico (7 PNG frames 16-256, 32-bit RGBA) and resources/icon.png (1024 master) are regenerated from the AwkitDarkBrandMark squircle brick-S geometry and no longer show the concept-1c spectrum mark.
The sidebar brand tile renders the shared AwkitDarkBrandMark (the private concept-1c SpecterAppIcon copy is removed), the build passes and the branding, design-token and offline verifiers pass.
Project state reconciled, the awkit-icon2 bead closed and exported, roadmap reads Sources agree, and no commit or push is made without owner authority.

evidence.command: npm run icon:generate (owner-run after e52e851; it renders app/renderer/assets/brand/awkit-app-icon.svg), then npm run verify:app-icon and a visual check of resources/icon.png
evidence.note: 2026-09-13: the owner's first generation run changed nothing because icon:generate defaulted to the stale resources/icon-source.png (fixed in e52e851), and the lease guard refuses npm run icon:generate to every agent role (refused under the release and project-state leases: [write-lease] BLOCKED: shell command is outside the active lease or the actor's role). Red before regeneration: verify:app-icon (79f3892) read FAIL 18/29 on the concept-1c icons - icon-source.png, icon.png and all 7 ICO frames off by mean channel diff 18.18-22.25, 53-68% of pixels off by >16. The owner then ran npm run icon:generate and the three files were committed in ed90b56. Green: verify:app-icon PASS 29/29 before that commit and twice more on committed ed90b56 - SVG render 1024x1024 with transparent corner, #7c3aed brick and #f6f6f6 S block; controls behave (generator-equivalent PNGs pass, a #8b5cf6 brick fails both the pixel match and the accent check, a 512px control fails); icon-source.png and icon.png match the render with the icon.png brick at #7c3aed; icon.ico reserved 0 / type 1 with 7 frames 256, 128, 64, 48, 32, 24, 16, each an in-bounds 32-bit PNG with 8-bit RGBA IHDR that matches the render at its size, 256 brick #7c3aed. Visual: resources/icon.png PASS (squircle brick-S, #7c3aed brick lower left, no spectrum mark). ICO frame visual NOT RUN: Read cannot open .ico and the browser pane refused the file:// URL, so the ICO half rests on the per-frame pixel match and 16/24/32 legibility is not visually confirmed.

Re-run 2026-09-13 on ed90b56 with the regenerated icons: PASS (453 records from 14 sources, tsc clean, bundles built; one pre-existing vite dynamic-import warning only); typecheck:scripts PASS; no tracked file changed.

completion.qc_note: Independent QC by the awkit-qc-reviewer subagent on the owner's explicit request (2026-09-13), not self-review: it reviewed 28fb9fb..a5c2944, 22 files all inside routing.expected_paths, with electron-builder.json, app/main/windowManager.ts and package-lock.json unchanged. awkit-app-icon.svg carries the AwkitDarkBrandMark shapes with only the accent brick baked as #7c3aed; the sidebar renders the shared decorative AwkitDarkBrandMark with SpecterAppIcon removed; global.css changed only a comment; package.json gained one script and no dependency; generate-app-icon.mjs defaults to the SVG, validates a 7-frame 32-bit RGBA PNG ICO before writing and writes only under resources/; verify-app-icon.mjs is read-only, exits 1 on failure, and its 29 checks and the 18/29 red run agree with its code; resources/icon.png visual PASS; ed90b56 holds only the three icon binaries. Verdict APPROVED, STATUS PASS, no blocker or major finding. Non-blocking findings: minor - SVG-to-TSX geometry parity is held only by a comment, since verify:app-icon proves the icons match the SVG but not that the SVG matches AwkitBrandMarks.tsx; minor - the verify-app-icon positive control is a lossless round-trip rather than a re-render tolerance control; nits - ICO directory planes, colorCount, reserved and minimum frame offset are unchecked, REPO_ROOT comes from process.cwd, SUPERSEDED_ACCENT #8b5cf6 is also the live dark-theme accent, the LeftNavigation comment overstates brick parity, the generate-app-icon missing-source message still says PNG, and verify-roadmap-dashboard comments still say blocked on the owner icon:generate run. NOT RUN by QC: build and verifier re-runs, node --check (refused by the lease guard), ICO byte and per-frame inspection, so 16/24/32 legibility stays unconfirmed.
